newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via $2.0 billion customer RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via $2.0 billion customer RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York added temporary reserves to the banking system on Tuesday via $2.0 billion customer repurchase agreements, a Fed spokeswoman said.
The Fed's add move was mostly in line with the market's expectations.
At 1130 EST/1630 GMT, the time the Fed usually intervenes in the market, the federal funds rate was quoted at 5-3/8 percent, well above the central bank's 5-1/4 percent target.
